subject: maths
question: What will be the amount (in Rs.) of a sum of Rs. 4,800 invested at compound interest at 15% per annum for 21over3 years, interest being compounded yearly (nearest to Rs. 1)?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 4800

Rate = 15%

Time = 21over3 years

**Concept used:**

1 year = 12 month

**Formula used:**

Amount = P(1 + r/100)t

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Amount = P(1 + r/100)t
